body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Spot LLC's SPOT Connect will be displayed at the 2011 International CES, which runs January 6-9, 2011 in Las Vegas, Nevada. The Innovations Design and Engineering Showcase will feature honorees by product category in the Grand Lobby of the Las Vegas Convention Center. For a complete list of Innovations 2011 Design and Engineering honoree products, visit www.CESweb.org/Innovations.

<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim – Real Time Posted by Smartphone>
